name: Mahnoor Jamshed
text: The institute offers an excellent learning environment with up-to-date resources and hands-on training. My trainer Manal is highly knowledgeable, approachable, and ensures every student gains practical skills and confidence. Highly recommend for anyone looking to advance their career!

name: Yulia Meshcheryakova
text: Now a days there are some schools in Dubai offering Beauty Therapy training courses. I'm feeling lucky that my choice was Nordic. Since the first impression and till now, my exams season, I feel welcomed and cared. Everyone from reception to trainers and directors are soooo friendly and supportive! About studying process and knowledge level: im more than pleased. Our group trainer Bianka is very experienced, and the level of her expertise is highly impressive. The groups are not that big (4-8 ppl), so you can expect an individual attention. Bianka is very supportive yet you'll be disciplined and pushed if necessary. That's the most demanding training method for me. The school has good relationships with DHA, so you don't have to bother of applying for the license - they'll do it for you. Nordic looks like a big family really - they remember their students and keeping in touch with them. Love it. I'd rate my experience 10 out of 10 (but don't get me wrong, sometimes studying process was very tough). Thums up, thinking to come again for another course!

name: Zana Mansoor
text: I wanted to take a moment to express my sincere gratitude and appreciation for NORDIC BEAUTY ACADEMY and to my trainer miss Lana 🌷 Even if i just entered LEV 2 i cant hold myself to express my grateful emotions with the academy🥹 U can find many academies around UAE but i can assure u that there is no other academies as professional as NORDIC , the environment, the staffs especially YVONNE 🍀 the welcoming and love and positivity they share is commendable 🍀and about miss lana omg guyz she is love and she is veryy very professional and expert in what she is doing✨🥰 i will never forget her in my life who paved way for my future🍀🥹 really i will be happy even if am having 7 days class straight lol ✨ I am delighted to leave a review and share my positive experiences with others✨ THANKYOU for consistently going above and beyond🍀🍀🍀

name: Nasim Golshan
text: I am forever grateful for the opportunities and experiences I gained during my time in Nordic academy .Thank you dear Menal for your unwavering support and guidance.I am immensely grateful for your patience and encouragement. you are the best beauty therapist by sense of peace .

name: naima naim
text: I had an amazing experience at Nordic International beauty and training center! The courses are well-structured, and the learning environment is incredibly supportive.Special shoutout to Manal and Bianca , who are exceptional teachers. They both are not only knowledgeable but also patient and attentive to each student’s learning needs. Their passion for the beauty industry truly shines through in their teaching. I highly recommend this school to anyone looking to excel in this field!
